applicabilityBasis.summary: CJPY targets one Japanese yen and can be minted and redeemed permissionlessly against ETH collateral. The reviewed materials establish a currency-referencing DeFi CDP, but no identified issuer obligation to repay national currency or a currency-denominated deposit. GENIUS section 2(22) therefore remains ambiguous rather than a verified payment-stablecoin classification.

genius.notes: The identifiable developer community and DAO are not established as a legal issuer owing yen redemption. issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. ETH collateral and protocol redemption documentation are public collateral disclosures, not qualifying cash reserves or an independent monthly reserve attestation. redemptionPolicyPresent is false for an issuer fiat-par policy; the protocol does publish an ETH redemption mechanism. GENIUS remains pre-effective in the reviewed federal landscape; not-yet-restricted records that posture only. No token-specific public regulatory action was located in the recorded searches.

Reopened Public Law 119-27, including sections 2(17), 2(22) and 3. Consulted the independently researched federal/state landscape briefs; proposed rules and SCRC procedural implementation do not approve named issuers.
negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no qualifying public GENIUS issuer approval, state qualification, official application, issuer-announced intent or foreign registration was located for cjpy-yamato in the independently opened token materials, NYDFS tables and named-token searches listed. This is a bounded public-evidence finding and does not exclude confidential or unindexed filings. Proposed implementing rules and ordinary licensing context do not establish token-specific GENIUS authorization.
